chunks: Ibn Muskan narrated from al-Halabi, who said:
Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said: “Any food in which you have specified a measure is not valid unspecifically by estimation.”

key_terms.كَيْلًا: a measured quantity or volumetric measure
key_terms.لَا يَصْلُحُ: it is not valid or proper
key_terms.مُجَازَفَةً: by rough estimation without exact measuring

ai.seo_question: Can food that is normally sold by measure be sold without measuring it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the sale of food items whose quantity is defined by measure. It indicates that when an item is of the kind sold by measured quantity, it should not be transacted merely by rough estimation without proper measurement.
